description: This file contains utility functions for exporting data to CSV and PDF formats in a health and fitness tracking web application. It provides methods to convert data objects into CSV format, trigger downloads, and generate printable HTML representations as PDF fallbacks.

methods.name: exportToCSV(rows, filename = 'export.csv')
methods.description: Converts an array of data objects to CSV format and triggers a file download with a given filename.

methods.name: exportToPDF(title, htmlContent)
methods.description: Creates a printable HTML view for PDF export via the browser print dialog, serving as a fallback for actual PDF generation.
